(image source: Official website) The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has issued the RRB JE CBT 1 answer key 2026 on its official website at rrb.digialm.com. Candidates can download the RRB JE CBT 1 provisional answer key by entering their login details such as registration number and date of birth. 
 The RRB JE 2026 provisional answer key pdf comprises correct answers to the questions asked in the exam. Candidates can raise objections against the RRB JE answer key and challenge it by November 17.
 Along with the provisional answer key, the railway board has also issued RRB JE response sheet 2026, answer key, and the question paper.
 The RRB JE CBT 1 examination 2026 was conducted on October 27, 28 and November 2. 
 Also read IBPS RRB PO admit card 2026 out at ibps.in; exam on November 21, 22 
 RRB JE CBT 1 2026 Answer Key: How to download 
 Candidates can download the RRB JE CBT 1 provisional answer key 2026 by following the steps given below.
 Go to the official website at rrb.digialm.com.
 Enter login details such as registration number and date of birth.
 Check the captcha and enter it correctly.
 Press the submit icon.
 RRB JE 2026 provisional answer key pdf will appear on the screen.
 Check details and download the answer key.
 Those who want to raise objections against the RRB JE CBT 1 provisional answer key 2026, should have to pay Rs 50 per challenge. If the board will find the raised objection to be correct, the amount will be refunded.
 Candidates can pay the objection fee through digital payments such as RuPay card or credit cards, UPI or the Net Banking.
